    A first-order functor on the projective corner trivializes the deformation #

    integral-deformations.tex (proof of Lemma 10.2): "If its value is zero, arrow changes remove all first-order mesh errors. The Hom category of the lifted modules becomes constant. Restricting to its actual projective corner trivializes the algebra deformation."

    Ring-generic form. Modules N_X over an R-algebra Λ carry first-order lifts of their actions for a cocycle μ; the arrows φ_a and their corrections g_a satisfy the mesh relations exactly and to first order. At projective labels p the module is regular, N_p ≅ e_pΛ with generator w_p and inverse ψ_p, its lifted action is the regular one, and evaluation at w_p identifies RQ(p, s) modulo the mesh ideal with N_p e_s. Then μ is a Hochschild coboundary (eq_hcobdry), through the derivation Δ(b) = ∑_p ψ_p Δ_p(w_p b) with Δ_p(n) = ∑_s δ(n e_s)(w_s).

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.CornerDeriv.Hyp {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {Λ : Type u_1} [Ring Λ] [Algebra R Λ] {GΛ : GExt.GAlg Λ} {μ : Λ →ₗ[R] Λ →ₗ[R] Λ} {q : ℤ} {V : Type} [Quiver V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (u : MeshCoefficients R Q) (N : V → Type v) [(X : V) → AddCommGroup (N X)] [(X : V) → Module R (N X)] (MM : (X : V) → GExt.GMod GΛ (N X)) (Lf : (X : V) → GExt.ActLift μ q (MM X)) (φ g : {y x : V} → (y ⟶ x) → N y →ₗ[R] N x) {P : Type} [Fintype P] (lab : P → V) (e : P → Λ) (w : (p : P) → N (lab p)) (ψ : (p : P) → N (lab p) →ₗ[R] Λ) :
    Prop

    The hypotheses of the projective corner argument.

    • e_idem (p : P) : e p * e p = e p
    • e_sum : ∑ p : P, e p = 1
    • φ_act {y x : V} (a : y ⟶ x) (m : N y) (b : Λ) : (φ a) (((MM y).act m) b) = ((MM x).act ((φ a) m)) b
    • lift {y x : V} (a : y ⟶ x) : GExt.IsLiftHom (Lf y) (Lf x) (φ a) (g a)
    • mesh (x : ↑Q.nonprojective) : ∑ a : (y : V) × (y ⟶ ↑x), ↑(u x a.fst a.snd) • φ a.snd ∘ₗ φ ((Q.mate x a.fst) a.snd) = 0
    • zmesh (x : ↑Q.nonprojective) : ∑ a : (y : V) × (y ⟶ ↑x), ↑(u x a.fst a.snd) • (φ a.snd ∘ₗ g ((Q.mate x a.fst) a.snd) + g a.snd ∘ₗ φ ((Q.mate x a.fst) a.snd)) = 0
    • w_e (p : P) : ((MM (lab p)).act (w p)) (e p) = w p
    • ψ_w (p : P) (b : Λ) : (ψ p) (((MM (lab p)).act (w p)) b) = e p * b
    • w_ψ (p : P) (n : N (lab p)) : ((MM (lab p)).act (w p)) ((ψ p) n) = n
    • reg (p : P) (n : N (lab p)) (b : Λ) : (Lf (lab p)).act n b = ((MM (lab p)).act (w p)) ((μ ((ψ p) n)) b)
    • surj (s p : P) (n : N (lab p)) : ((MM (lab p)).act n) (e s) = n → ∃ (F : LinearPaths.obj (lab s) ⟶ LinearPaths.obj (lab p)), ((PathEval.evL N fun {y x : V} => φ) F) (w s) = n
    • inj (s p : P) (F : LinearPaths.obj (lab s) ⟶ LinearPaths.obj (lab p)) : ((PathEval.evL N fun {y x : V} => φ) F) (w s) = 0 → F ∈ (CategoricalIdeal.HomIdeal.linearSpan R (meshRelations u)).hom (LinearPaths.obj (lab s)) (LinearPaths.obj (lab p))
